## **Bugs et stabilité** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs et stabilité.**
      17 avis récents mentionnent bugs et stabilité.
      Fenêtre d'avis : 9 juil. 2026 - 3 oct. 2026
      **Pourquoi c'est important:** Les utilisateurs mentionnent des crashes ou de l'instabilité. À traiter comme actionnable seulement en cas de pic ou après une mise à jour ; sinon souvent du bruit de baseline.

         **Exemples d'avis:**
            1. _CheshireOctopus_, 3 oct. 2026, 1/5: "This app was great up until mid-2026. Recently introduced updates are incredibly buggy and the new UX is a disaster. App blocking is no longer dependable, stats are inaccurate, and the design is messy. Feels like the developers leaned into AI slop. Very unfortunate. Hate to see a great product fail like this."
            2. _Tomito6_, 2 oct. 2026, 1/5: "I payed this app for almost a year. Not worth it at all! I found a much better app that was not 20€ per month. And let me tell you that this app also often didn’t work. It’s super buggy!! For some reason my instagram always seemed to unlock between 23-24 (even if I put a lot of extra rules or changed stuff) it also often didn’t revognize time limits so it’s quite literally not doing it’s only purpose, while demanding 20€. Hoooorrrribble app. Migrated to a new one and wish I could go back in time to avoid this scam"
            3. _A136P_, 24 sept. 2026, 1/5: "I was using this app for over a year and really liked it. At some point that had a huge system update and since then it would glitch constantly and lag. I have ended up deleting it as a result"
